title: 2027 Wolfram Winter School
description:
The Wolfram Science Winter School 2027 will be held online January 4–15, 2027, with a self-guided week of reading and learning December 28, 2026–January 1, 2027. During the program, all program events will take place between 9am and 9pm US Eastern Time. For more information about the Wolfram Science Winter School, please visit our website for more information about the program or contact our team with any questions.

The Winter School application is hosted by the Wolfram Research recruiting system. Admission to the Wolfram Science Winter School is a multistep process. The quality of your application contributes toward your successful admission to the school. Admission is done on a rolling basis and spots fill quickly, so early applicants have a higher chance of acceptance.

The Wolfram Science Winter School is only able to accept participants who will be 18 years of age or older on January 4, 2027. Once you have completed the application form, click "Submit Application." Fields marked with an * are required.

Please note: we want to hear from you, not from generative AI. Your application will be read by humans, some of whom work on LLMs and all of whom have seen a lot of LLM-generated text. The only thing we consider to be an acceptable use of LLM text generation is for language translation. We value the content of your application over the presentation of that content.

title: International Business Development Executive—Tokyo, Japan
description:
Wolfram, creator of Mathematica, Wolfram|Alpha and Wolfram Language, has an exciting opportunity for an International Business Development Executive to join our International Business Development team. This person will be considered a primary contact at Wolfram, using excellent presentation and interpersonal skills to work directly with current and potential customers in the Japanese market.

 

Responsibilities

  • Maintain and grow sales by:
    • Serving as the primary point of contact to grow B2B sales and relationships in the region
    • Meeting with and/or presenting to current and prospective customers in Japan, virtually and in person
    • Utilizing our CRM to generate quotes and track quote-to-sale success
    • Executing a call/email plan to ensure all leads and potential customers receive intelligent and action-oriented next steps
    • Maintaining the sales pipeline of opportunities and closed sales as well as accurately providing forecasting information for expected sales to sales management
    • Expanding existing customers’ usage of Wolfram technology and services

Qualifications

  • A desire to network with decision makers and build/create business
  • Knowledge of the Japanese commercial, government and university markets
  • Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills
  • Strong work ethic and the ability to network
  • Ability to articulate ideas and instructions

Location: Tokyo, Japan (alternate locations within Japan considered)

Job type: Full time (40 hours per week)/Independent Contractor
Reporting to: Regional Office Manager

Wolfram is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity at its company. Women, people of color, members of the LGBTQ community, individuals with disabilities and veterans are strongly encouraged to apply.

title: Business Development Executive —Oxfordshire, UK
description:
We are looking for a highly organised, proactive Business Development professional to join our team, to be responsible for managing and developing our work with Government, education and training providers at all levels, as well as assessment bodies and content delivery companies worldwide. The successful candidate will have a STEM background, gained through education or relevant professional experience.

Reports to: CEO

Responsibilities:

  • Developing strategy for researching existing and new leads
  • Building and managing stakeholder relationships in across technical, Government, education and training providers
  • Pro-active account planning and delivery to achieve set targets and produce continued growth
  • Co-ordinating with team to arrange demonstrations, talks and other events
  • Tracking and providing reports on progress

Required/Ideal Skills:
•    Educated to degree level in a technical subject would be an advantage, E.g. maths, physics, engineering, computer science, or related technical or quantitative field
•    Proven track record in sales in a similar industry– 2 years minimum preferred
•    Target orientated and capable of working under pressure on own initiative, often on multiple projects
•    Strong decision-making, problem-solving, organisational and negotiation skills
•    Excellent interpersonal, verbal and written communication skills
•    Analytical and presentation skills
•    Strong work ethic and ability to network
•    A high level of numeracy and attention to detail will be required

It is also desirable to have the following:
•    Clear understanding of computational thinking processes
•    The ability to code 
•    An understanding of software or content production processes 
•    An appreciation of user experience and design

 

Hybrid working with a Office:Home / 60:40 split

title: Strategic Development Manager—Oxfordshire, UK
description:
This position works with senior management to take, further develop and drive delivery of strategic business opportunities and internal initiatives. It involves incisive understanding of complex technical and business scenarios to keep focus energetically in working with a wide variety of groups and customers and building solutions.

 

Reports to: CEO

 

Responsibilities:

  • Leading strategic business discussions to drive relationship development, negotiate opportunities, and secure new business agreements
  • Transforming discussions, ideas and company priorities into clear and structured outputs that enable better decision-making and execution across the business
  • Managing strategic project timelines and stakeholder communication
  • Driving the execution of marketing strategy including approach, campaigns, social media and event engagement
  • Identifying activities to be automated, and implementing with AI/Wolfram technologies
  • Aligning key leads, opportunities and communication efforts with business objectives through to execution
  • Overseeing the marketing output and aligning communications, visions and events with strategic goals
  • Supporting the CEO’s administration team ensuring that actions align with strategic goals


Required/ideal skills:

  • Strong technical background and interest in technology, software, science or mathematics
  • Incisiveness of understanding, ability to cross-examine and clarify
  • Self-motivated and a pro-active approach to all tasks. Able to use own initiative
  • Experience of project management methodologies and strategic project delivery
  • Highly organised – able to prioritise workload, complete multiple tasks to deadlines and work under pressure
  • Perceptive, with the ability to apply judgement, common sense and find practical solutions
  • Able to communicate well at high level both externally and internally. Ability to adapt style of communication accordingly
  • Management experience is an advantage, enjoys leading and mentoring a group
  • Experience leading cross-function projects including system/program usage is advantageous 

This full-time role offers hybrid remote. Office:Home / 60:40

Wolfram is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity at its company.

title: International Business Developer - System Modeler Consulting—Linköping, Sweden
description:
Wolfram, creator of Mathematica, Wolfram|Alpha and Wolfram Language, is seeking a highly motivated International Business Developer to drive growth for its System Modeler consulting services. This position offers an exciting opportunity to work at the intersection of advanced modeling, simulation and AI, engaging with innovative companies and research organizations around the world.

Responsibilities

  • Developing and executing strategies to expand Wolfram’s System Modeler consulting business internationally
  • Identifying and engaging with potential clients in industries such as energy, automotive, aerospace, medtech and industrial automation
  • Collaborating with the technical consulting and product development teams to create customized proposals and demonstrate the value of model-based design, digital twins and AI-integrated simulation
  • Managing the entire sales cycle, from lead generation to closing, and building long-term relationships with clients and partners
  • Representing Wolfram MathCore at industry events, conferences and trade fairs
  • Contributing to market analysis, business forecasting and strategic planning for the consulting division

Qualifications

  • Fluent in English (other languages are a plus)
  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering, business or a related technical field
  • 5+ years of experience in international business development or sales, ideally within engineering software or technical services
  • Excellent interpersonal, presentation and negotiation skills
  • Strong understanding of modeling and simulation tools; familiarity with Modelica, FMI or Wolfram System Modeler is a plus
  • Proven ability to develop client relationships across different markets and cultures
  • Ability to work independently and travel internationally as needed

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience in B2B technical consulting or SaaS business development
  • Background in systems engineering, AI or industrial simulation
  • Understanding of contract terms, NDAs and compliance issues

Location: Linköping, Sweden
Job type: Full time (40 hours per week)/Permanent
Reporting to: CEO of Wolfram MathCore

Wolfram is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity at its company. Women, people of color, members of the LGBTQ community, individuals with disabilities and veterans are strongly encouraged to apply.

title: Wolfram Student Ambassador Initiative
description:
Wolfram Student Ambassador Initiative is open to high school, college, and post-graduate students with Wolfram Langauge skills.

The Wolfram Student Ambassador Initiative is designed for outstanding students to develop technical and leadership skills and to get access to a global network of peers. You might find your next project partner, cofounder, mentor, or friend in our lively community.

The Initiative is focused on driving positive grass-roots change in STEAM classrooms, bringing high-powered software to learning groups at all levels. Ambassadors come from high schools and universities all over the world, and they work to inspire people to engage with STEAM by writing computational essays, helping answer questions online, creating content on a variety of platforms and publishing research.

If you are a student in high school or university at any level, have some experience with Wolfram technologies, and are excited at the prospect of joining a thriving community, teaching and inspiring others, and getting access to opportunities in technology, we encourage you to apply to join the Initiative.

Students customize their ambassadorship to suit their aspirations, skills and abilities. In collaboration with their program coordinator, students set goals and challenges for themselves and get support and mentorship to complete projects. Students have the opportunity to attend workshops focused on career development, math, chemistry, video game design, data science, design thinking and coding, as well as access to technical support, opportunities for internships and jobs, and opportunities to shape the direction of future Wolfram education programs.

Eligibility Requirements:

  • Located in any country
  • Enrolled in an educational institution or similar
  • Minimum age 14
  • Wolfram Language user

 For more information, see our website.
